caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, boxed scene bordered by a green fence with vertical posts and golden brown pillars at the corners. Inside the enclosure, there are two human figures standing on either side of a large, brown tree with green foliage and red fruits at the top. Both figures are nude except for green leafy coverings around their waists, and each holds a red fruit in one hand. A large serpent, colored brown with some green patterning, is coiled around the trunk of the tree, with its head extending toward one of the figures near the fruit. The green color of the fence and tree foliage contrasts with the earthy brown tones of the trunk, pillars, and figures’ skin, and red highlights appear in the fruits. The entire scene is set against a plain, light-colored background with no additional elements.
title: Adam and Eve
